translations.idiomatic: ○ Court audience formation order; rotating audiences by officials; regulations governing how officials greet one another

sentences.zh: 朝儀班序。

translations.literal: Court audience formation order.
translations.idiomatic: Court audience formation order.

sentences.zh: 太祖建隆三年三月，有司上合班儀：太師，太傅，太保，太尉，司徒，司空， 太子太師、太傅、太保，嗣王，郡王，左、右僕射，太子少師、少傅、少保，三京牧，大都督，大都護，御史大夫，六尚書，常侍，門下、中書侍郎，太子賓客，太 常、宗正卿，御史中丞，左右諫議大夫，給事中，中書舍人，左、右丞，諸行侍郎，秘書監，光祿、衛尉、太僕、大理、鴻臚、司農、太府卿，國子祭酒，殿中、少 府、將作監，前任節度使，開封、河南、太原尹，太子詹事，諸王傅，司天監，五府尹，國公，郡公，中都督，上都護，下都督，太子左右庶子，五大都督府長史， 中都護，下都護，太常、宗正少卿，秘書少監，光祿等七寺少卿，司業，三少監，三少尹，少詹事，左右諭德、家令、率更令、仆，諸王府長史、司馬，司天少監， 起居舍人，侍御史，殿中侍御史，左右補闕、拾遺，監察御史，郎中、員外郎，太常博士，五府少尹，五大都督府司馬，通事舍人，國子博士，五經博士，都水使 者，四赤令，太常、宗正、秘書丞，著作郎，殿中丞，尚食、尚藥、尚舍、尚乘、尚輦奉御，大理正，太子中允、讚善、中舍、洗馬，諸王友、諮議參軍，司天五官 正。

sentences.zh: 凡雜坐者，以此為準。

translations.literal: For all miscellaneous seating, this was to be the standard.
translations.idiomatic: For all informal seating arrangements, this order was to serve as the standard.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「尚書中台，萬事之本，而班位率次兩省官；

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Secretariat is the central platform and the root of all affairs, yet its formation rank generally followed after the officials of the two provinces;
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "The Secretariat is the central administration and the foundation of all government business, yet in formation its rank generally came after the officials of the two provinces;

sentences.zh: 節度使出總方面，古諸侯也，又其檢校兼守官多至師傅三公，而位居九寺卿監之下， 甚無謂也。

translations.literal: the Military Governor goes forth to command a region and is the ancient feudal lord, and moreover many of those holding concurrent inspection and acting posts reach as high as Grand Tutor or the Three Excellencies, yet their rank stands below the directors of the Nine Courts and directorates—this is quite meaningless.
translations.idiomatic: a military commissioner goes out to govern a region like the feudal lords of old, and many who hold concurrent inspection or acting appointments rise as high as grand tutor or the three excellencies, yet they were ranked below the directors of the nine courts and directorates—an arrangement that made little sense.

sentences.zh: 其給事、諫議、舍人宜降於六曹侍郎之下，補闕次郎中，拾遺、監察次員外郎，節度使升於六曹侍郎之上、中書侍郎之下，餘悉如故。」

translations.literal: The Supervising Secretariat Drafter, Remonstrance Officials, and Secretariat Drafters should be lowered below the Vice Ministers of the Six Ministries; Supplementation Officials should follow Directors; Selection and Investigating Officials should follow Vice Directors; Military Governors should be raised above the Vice Ministers of the Six Ministries and below the Vice Ministers of the Central Secretariat; all else remains as before."
translations.idiomatic: The supervising drafters, remonstrance officials, and secretariat drafters should rank below the vice ministers of the six ministries; supplementation officials should follow directors; selection and investigating censors should follow vice directors; military commissioners should rank above the six-ministry vice ministers but below the central secretariat vice ministers; everything else should remain unchanged."

sentences.zh: 乾德元年閏十二月，詔：「自今一品致仕官曾帶平章事者，朝會宜綴中書門下班。」

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month of the first year of Qiande, an edict stated: "From now on, first-rank officials in retirement who had once held the post of Director of Affairs should at court audiences join the rank below the Central Secretariat and Gate Office."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month of the first year of Qiande, an edict stated: "From now on, first-rank officials in retirement who had once held the post of Director of Affairs should at court audiences join the rank below the Central Secretariat and Gate Office."

sentences.zh: 二年二月，詔重定內外官儀製。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year, an edict re-fixed the ritual regulations for inner and outer officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, an edict re-fixed the ritual regulations for inner and outer officials.

sentences.zh: 有司請令上將軍在中書侍郎之下，大將軍在少卿監之下，諸衛率、副率在東宮五品之下，內客省使視太卿，客省使視太監，引進使視庶子，判四方館事視少卿，閣門使視少監，諸司使視郎中，客省引進、閣門副使視員外郎，諸司副使視太常博士，通事舍人從本品，供奉官視諸衛率，殿直視副率，樞密承旨視四品朝官，兼南班官諸司使者從本品，副承旨視寺監丞，諸房副承旨視南省都事。

translations.literal: The relevant offices requested that Senior Generals rank below Vice Ministers of the Central Secretariat, Grand Generals below Vice Directors and Directors of the courts and directorates, commanders and vice-commanders of the guards below fifth rank in the Eastern Palace, the Commissioner of the Inner Reception Office be treated like a Grand Minister, the Commissioner of the Reception Office be treated like a Director, the Introduction Commissioner be treated like a Subordinate of the Heir Apparent, the official in charge of the Four Directions Hostel be treated like a Vice Director, the Gate Commissioner be treated like a Vice Director of a directorate, commissioners of the various offices be treated like Directors of ministries, the deputy commissioners of the Reception and Introduction and Gate Offices be treated like Vice Directors of ministries, deputy commissioners of the various offices be treated like Doctors of Rites, Heralds retain their regular rank, supply officials be treated like commanders of the guards, palace attendants be treated like vice-commanders, the Commissioner-in-Chief of Military Affairs be treated like fourth-rank court officials, commissioners of the various offices who also held southern-rank concurrent posts retain their regular rank, the Vice Commissioner-in-Chief be treated like directors of courts and directorates, and the vice commissioners-in-chief of the various bureaus be treated like secretariat directors of the southern province.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices requested that senior generals rank below vice ministers of the Central Secretariat, grand generals below vice directors and directors of the courts and directorates, commanders and vice-commanders of the guards below fifth rank in the Eastern Palace, the commissioner of the Inner Reception Office be treated like a grand minister, the commissioner of the Reception Office be treated like a director, the introduction commissioner be treated like a subordinate of the heir apparent, the official in charge of the Four Directions Hostel be treated like a vice director, the gate commissioner be treated like a vice director of a directorate, commissioners of the various offices be treated like directors of ministries, the deputy commissioners of the Reception and Introduction and Gate Offices be treated like vice directors of ministries, deputy commissioners of the various offices be treated like doctors of rites, heralds retain their regular rank, supply officials be treated like commanders of the guards, palace attendants be treated like vice-commanders, the commissioner-in-chief of military affairs be treated like fourth-rank court officials, commissioners of the various offices who also held southern-rank concurrent posts retain their regular rank, the vice commissioner-in-chief be treated like directors of courts and directorates, and the vice commissioners-in-chief of the various bureaus be treated like secretariat directors of the southern province.

sentences.zh: 凡視朝官者本品下，視京官在其上。

translations.literal: In all cases, those treated as court officials ranked below their regular rank, while those treated as capital officials ranked above it.
translations.idiomatic: In all cases, those treated as court officials ranked below their regular rank, while those treated as capital officials ranked above it.

sentences.zh: 開寶六年九月，詔曰：「周之宗盟，異姓為後，此先王所以睦九族而和萬邦也。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Kaibao, an edict said: "In the Zhou clan alliance, those of a different surname were made successors—this is how the former kings brought the nine kindred into harmony and united the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Kaibao, an edict declared: "In the Zhou system of clan alliances, those of a different surname could be made successors—this was how the former kings harmonized the nine kindred and brought the myriad states into accord.

sentences.zh: 晉王親賢莫二，位望俱崇，方資夾輔之功，俾先三事之列，宜位宰相上。」

translations.literal: The Prince of Jin was second to none in kinship and worth, and his position and prestige were both lofty; he was just then to be relied on for supporting assistance, and should be placed ahead of the three chief ministers—he ought to rank above the chief counselors."
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Jin was without peer in kinship and merit, and both his standing and prestige were supreme; as he was now to be entrusted with supporting the throne, he should take precedence over the three chief ministers and rank above the chief counselors."

sentences.zh: 九年十一月，詔齊王廷美、武功郡王德昭位在宰相上。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the ninth year, an edict placed Prince of Qi Tingmei and Prince of Wugong Commandery Dezhao above the chief counselors.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the ninth year, an edict placed the Prince of Qi, Tingmei, and the Prince of Wugong Commandery, Dezhao, above the chief counselors.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年正月，有司上酺宴班位。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the relevant offices submitted the seating arrangements for the feast distribution.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the relevant offices submitted the seating arrangements for the feast distribution.

sentences.zh: 駙馬都尉、宮僚、員僚、皇親大將軍已下，行門、宰臣、樞密使已下，潁王、皇親郡王、侍衛馬軍都指揮使已下，皇親使相、皇親節度使、皇親觀察留後已下，皇親防禦、團練、刺史三班合為一；

translations.literal: Imperial sons-in-law, palace staff, staff officials, and imperial kinsmen from Grand General downward; gate officials, chief counselors, and commissioners of military affairs downward; the Prince of Ying, imperial kinsmen who were commandery princes, and commanders of the Palace Cavalry and Horse Armies downward; imperial kinsmen who held the commissioner rank, imperial kinsmen who were military commissioners, and imperial kinsmen who were observation commissioners-in-waiting downward—the three ranks of defense commissioners, training commissioners, and prefects were combined into one;
translations.idiomatic: Imperial sons-in-law, palace staff, staff officials, and imperial kinsmen from grand general downward; gate officials, chief counselors, and commissioners of military affairs downward; the Prince of Ying, imperial kinsmen who were commandery princes, and commanders of the Palace Cavalry and Horse Armies downward; imperial kinsmen who held the commissioner rank, imperial kinsmen who were military commissioners, and imperial kinsmen who were observation commissioners-in-waiting downward—the three ranks of defense commissioners, training commissioners, and prefects were combined into one;

sentences.zh: 節度使、觀察留後已下，防禦、團練、刺史三班合為一，並重行異位。

translations.literal: Military commissioners and observation commissioners-in-waiting downward—the three ranks of defense commissioners, training commissioners, and prefects were combined into one rank, each forming separate rows at different positions.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioners and observation commissioners-in-waiting downward—the three ranks of defense commissioners, training commissioners, and prefects were combined into one rank, each forming separate rows at different positions.

sentences.zh: 詔依所定。

translations.literal: An edict approved what had been fixed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved what had been fixed.

sentences.zh: 既而武康軍節度使李端願言：「使相亦當合為一班，不當獨行尊異。」

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Li Duanyuan, Military Commissioner of Wukang Army, said: "Commissioners with the commissioner rank should also be combined into one rank and should not form a separate rank with special precedence."
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward Li Duanyuan, military commissioner of Wukang Army, said: "Commissioners with the commissioner rank should also be combined into one rank and should not form a separate rank with special precedence."

sentences.zh: 詔令閣門再定，而閣門引儀製及以前議為是。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Gate Office to fix it again, but the Gate Office cited the ritual regulations and the earlier decision as correct.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Gate Office to fix it again, but the Gate Office cited the ritual regulations and the earlier decision as correct.

sentences.zh: 端願復伸其議，自劾妄言。

translations.literal: Duanyuan again pressed his proposal and impeached himself for reckless speech.
translations.idiomatic: Duanyuan again pressed his proposal and impeached himself for reckless speech.

sentences.zh: 乃詔太常禮院與御史臺同詳定。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Censorate jointly to examine and fix the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Censorate jointly to examine and fix the matter.

sentences.zh: 禮院言：「常朝起居班次，緣祖宗舊制，不宜並合。」

translations.literal: The Court of Rites said: "The ranks for regular audience and bowing follow the ancestral institutions and should not be combined."
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Rites said: "The ranks for regular audience and bowing follow the ancestral institutions and should not be combined."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 四年閏三月，太常禮院、閣門言：「準詔同詳定閣門使李端愨所奏閣門儀製，宰臣與 親王立班坐位分左右各為班首，宰臣、樞密使帶使相，或帶郡王並使相作一行，總為中書門下班。

translations.literal: In the intercalary third month of the fourth year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate Office reported: "Pursuant to the edict jointly to examine and fix the gate regulations submitted by Gate Commissioner Li Duanque, when chief counselors and imperial princes form ranks and take their seats, left and right each have a head of rank; chief counselors and Commissioners of Military Affairs who hold the commissioner rank, or who hold both a commandery prince and commissioner rank together in one row, are altogether the rank of the Central Secretariat and Gate Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month of the fourth year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate Office reported: "Pursuant to an edict to examine jointly the gate regulations submitted by Gate Commissioner Li Duanque, when chief counselors and imperial princes form ranks and take their seats, each side has its own head of rank; chief counselors and commissioners of military affairs who hold the commissioner rank, or who hold both a commandery prince title and commissioner rank in one row, together constitute the Central Secretariat and Gate Office rank.

sentences.zh: 其親王獨行一班者，準封爵令。

translations.literal: Where an imperial prince forms a rank alone, this follows the regulations on enfeoffment and titles.
translations.idiomatic: When an imperial prince stands in a rank by himself, that follows the regulations on enfeoffment and titles.

sentences.zh: 兄弟皇子皆封國，謂之親王，所以 他官不可參綴。

translations.literal: The emperor's brothers and sons who are all enfeoffed with states are called imperial princes; therefore other offices may not be intercalated among them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's brothers and sons who receive state enfeoffments are called imperial princes; for that reason no other office may be inserted into their rank.

sentences.zh: 檢會坐次圖，直將宗室使相輒綴親王，蓋更張之時未見親王，遂致失於講求。

translations.literal: On examining the seating-order charts, one finds that imperial-clan commissioners holding the commissioner rank were directly intercalated with imperial princes—probably because at the time of the change no imperial princes were present, so the inquiry was neglected.
translations.idiomatic: On examining the seating-order charts, one finds that imperial-clan commissioners were simply intercalated with imperial princes—likely because when the charts were redrawn no imperial princes were present, and the matter was never properly reviewed.

sentences.zh: 近見朝拜景靈宮，東陽郡王顥亦綴親王班，竊恐未安。

translations.literal: Recently at the audience worshiping at Jingling Palace, the Prince of Dongyang Commandery, Hao, was also intercalated in the imperial-prince rank, which we fear is improper.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, at the audience worshiping at Jingling Palace, the Prince of Dongyang Commandery, Hao, was also placed in the imperial-prince rank, which we fear is improper.

sentences.zh: 今取到閣門儀 製，其合班宰臣、使相在東，親王在西，分班立。

translations.literal: We have now obtained the gate regulations: at joint formation the chief counselors and commissioners are on the east, the imperial princes on the west, standing in separate ranks.
translations.idiomatic: We have now obtained the gate regulations: at joint formation the chief counselors and commissioners stand on the east, the imperial princes on the west, each in separate ranks.

sentences.zh: 又祥符元年宴坐次圖，宰臣王旦與使相石保吉在東，寧王元偓、舒王元偁、廣陵郡王元儼、節度使惟吉在西，分班 坐。

translations.literal: Again, in the seating chart for the banquet of the first year of Xiangfu, Chief Counselor Wang Dan and Commissioner Shi Baoji were on the east; Prince of Ning Yuanwei, Prince of Shu Yuancheng, Prince of Guangling Commandery Yuanyan, and Military Commissioner Weiji were on the west, seated in separate ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Again, in the seating chart for the banquet of the first year of Xiangfu, Chief Counselor Wang Dan and Commissioner Shi Baoji sat on the east; the Prince of Ning, Yuanwei, the Prince of Shu, Yuancheng, the Prince of Guangling Commandery, Yuanyan, and Military Commissioner Weiji sat on the west, each in separate ranks.

sentences.zh: 其元儼、惟吉是郡王與節度使，許綴親王班，竊慮當時出自特旨。

translations.literal: Yuanyan and Weiji were a commandery prince and a military commissioner permitted to be intercalated in the imperial-prince rank—we fear that at the time this came from a special order.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyan and Weiji were a commandery prince and a military commissioner who were allowed to join the imperial-prince rank—we suspect that at the time this came from a special directive.

sentences.zh: 今來檢尋元初文字不見，在先朝隻依祥符元年宴坐次圖子，親王及帶使相郡王在西為一班。

translations.literal: On searching the original documents now, none are found; in the former court one relied only on the seating chart for the banquet of the first year of Xiangfu, with imperial princes and commandery princes holding the commissioner rank on the west as one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On searching the original documents, none can be found; in the former court one relied only on the seating chart for the Xiangfu banquet of the first year, with imperial princes and commandery princes holding the commissioner rank on the west as one rank.

sentences.zh: 臣 等參詳，請依閣門儀製，親王在西，獨為一班，宗室郡王帶使相許綴親王立班坐次，即係臨時特旨。」

translations.literal: We your subjects have examined the matter in detail and request that, following the gate regulations, imperial princes stand on the west in a rank by themselves; commandery princes of the imperial clan who hold the commissioner rank may be permitted to join the imperial princes in rank and seating only when there is a temporary special order."
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects have examined the matter in detail and request that, following the gate regulations, imperial princes stand on the west in a rank by themselves; commandery princes of the imperial clan who hold the commissioner rank may join the imperial princes in rank and seating only when there is a temporary special directive."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年四月，國信所言：「大遼賀同天 節左番使耶律奭赴文德殿拜表，言南使到北朝綴翰林學士班，今來卻在節度使之下。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Xining, the Office of Credentials reported: "The left envoy of the Great Liao, Yelü Shi, coming to offer felicitations on the Shared Heaven Festival, presented his memorial at the Wende Hall and said that when southern envoys arrive in the northern court they are intercalated in the Hanlin Academician rank, but on this occasion he is placed below the Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Xining, the Office of Credentials reported: "The left envoy of the Great Liao, Yelü Shi, coming to offer felicitations on the Shared Heaven Festival, presented his memorial at Wende Hall and said that when southern envoys arrive at the northern court they join the Hanlin Academician rank, but on this occasion he has been placed below the military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 館伴者諭之，始就班。

translations.literal: The host official instructed him, and only then did he take his rank.
translations.idiomatic: The host official instructed him, and only then did he take his proper place in rank.

sentences.zh: 時下御史臺、閣門同詳定，奏稱人使不知本朝翰林學士班 自在節度使之下，如遇合班即節度使在翰林學士之西差前，別為一班立，俱不相壓。

translations.literal: At the time the Censorate and the Gate Office jointly examined the matter and memorialized that the envoy did not know that in this court the Hanlin Academician rank is naturally below the Military Governor; when there is joint formation the Military Governor stands slightly ahead to the west of the Hanlin Academician, each forming a separate rank, and neither presses upon the other.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Censorate and the Gate Office jointly examined the matter and reported that the envoy did not know that in this court the Hanlin Academician rank naturally stands below the military commissioner; when ranks are combined, the military commissioner stands slightly ahead to the west of the Hanlin academician, each in a separate rank, and neither supersedes the other.

sentences.zh: 欲且依久來儀製體例。」

translations.literal: They wished for the time being to follow the long-standing ritual precedent."
translations.idiomatic: They proposed to follow the long-standing ritual precedent for the time being."

sentences.zh: 詔依所定。

translations.literal: An edict followed what had been fixed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved what had been determined.

sentences.zh: 是月，編修閣門儀製所言：「慶曆中，改文 明殿學士為觀文殿學士，又置大學士。

translations.literal: In that month, those compiling the gate regulations reported: "In the Qingli era the Wénmíng Hall Academician was changed to Guānwén Hall Academician, and a Grand Academician was also established.
translations.idiomatic: That month, those compiling the gate regulations reported: "In the Qingli era the Wénmíng Hall Academician title was changed to Guānwén Hall Academician, and a Grand Academician post was also established.

sentences.zh: 按文明殿即今文德殿，乃正衙前殿也，後唐始置學士，序位樞密副使之下，每遇紫宸殿坐朝，則升殿侍立。

translations.literal: According to precedent, the Wénmíng Hall is today's Wende Hall, which is the main front hall of the outer court; the Hanlin Academy was first established in the Later Tang, with rank below the Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs; whenever there was audience at the Zichen Hall they ascended the hall to attend standing.
translations.idiomatic: According to precedent, the Wénmíng Hall is today's Wende Hall, the main front hall of the outer court; the Hanlin Academy was first established in the Later Tang, ranked below the vice commissioner of military affairs; whenever there was audience at Zichen Hall they ascended the hall to attend standing.

sentences.zh: 蓋文德、紫宸通謂 之前殿，故學士侍立為宜。

translations.literal: Since Wende and Zichen are both generally called the front halls, it is fitting that academicians attend standing.
translations.idiomatic: Since Wende and Zichen are both commonly called the front halls, it is appropriate that academicians attend standing there.

sentences.zh: 其觀文殿深在禁中，乃與資政、端明殿相類，而資政、端明學士並不侍立。

translations.literal: The Guānwén Hall lies deep within the inner palace and is of the same type as the Zīzhèng and Duānmíng Halls, yet the Zīzhèng and Duānmíng academicians do not attend standing.
translations.idiomatic: The Guānwén Hall lies deep within the inner palace and is of the same type as the Zīzhèng and Duānmíng Halls, yet academicians of those halls do not attend standing.

sentences.zh: 竊詳慶曆所改職名，雖用舊之班著，而殿之次序與舊義理不 同。

translations.literal: We have examined in detail the titles changed in Qingli: although the old rank order was used, the sequence of the halls and the original rationale are not the same.
translations.idiomatic: On careful examination, the titles changed in Qingli used the old rank order, but the sequence of the halls and the original rationale no longer matched.

sentences.zh: 其觀文殿大學士自今遇紫宸殿坐朝，請更不升殿侍立。」

translations.literal: Henceforth when there is audience at the Zichen Hall, the Guānwén Hall Grand Academician should no longer ascend the hall to attend standing."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, when there is audience at Zichen Hall, the Guānwén Hall Grand Academician should no longer ascend the hall to attend standing."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年五月，詔：「太師平章軍國重事文彥博，已降旨令獨班起居。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Yuanyou, an edict said: "Grand Preceptor and Director of State Affairs Wen Yanbo has already been ordered by special edict to form a rank alone at audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Yuanyou, an edict stated: "Grand Preceptor and Director of State Affairs Wen Yanbo has already been ordered by special edict to form a rank alone at audience.

sentences.zh: 自今赴經筵、都堂同三省、樞密院奏事，並序位在宰臣之上。」

translations.literal: From now on, when he goes to the classics lecture or to the chief hall together with the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs to report affairs, his order of rank shall be above the chief counselors."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, when he attends the classics lecture or reports affairs in the chief hall together with the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs, his order of rank shall be above the chief counselors."

sentences.zh: 百官轉對。

translations.literal: Rotating audience by the myriad officials.
translations.idiomatic: Rotating audience by officials.

sentences.zh: 自建隆詔內殿起居日，令百官以次轉對，限以二人。

translations.literal: From Jianlong an edict on days of inner-hall audience ordered the myriad officials to offer rotating audience in turn, limited to two persons.
translations.idiomatic: From the Jianlong era, an edict on days of inner-hall audience ordered officials to offer rotating audience in turn, limited to two persons at a time.

sentences.zh: 其封章於閣門通進，復鞠躬自奏，宣徽使承旨宣答，拜舞而出，著為閣門儀製。

translations.literal: Their sealed memorials were forwarded through the Gate Office; they again bowed and reported in person; the Commissioner of the Palace Directorate received the edict and announced the reply; they bowed and danced and withdrew—this was established as gate regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Their sealed memorials were forwarded through the Gate Office; they bowed again and reported in person; the commissioner of the palace directorate received the edict and announced the reply; they bowed, performed the dance of obeisance, and withdrew—this was established as gate regulation.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年，詔：自今內殿起居日，復令常參官二人次對，閣門受其章。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua, an edict said: From now on on days of inner-hall audience, regular-attendance officials again should offer second audience two at a time, and the Gate Office receives their memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunhua, an edict ordered that from then on, on days of inner-hall audience, regular-attendance officials should again offer second audience two at a time, with the Gate Office receiving their memorials.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符末，罷不復行。

translations.literal: At the end of the Dazhong Xiangfu era it was abolished and not revived.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Dazhong Xiangfu era the practice was abolished and not revived.

sentences.zh: 景德三年，復詔：「群臣轉對，其在外京官內殿崇班以上，候得替，先具民間利害實封，於閣門上進，方得朝見。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingde, an edict was restored: "When the host of ministers offers rotating audience, those among outer capital officials of Inner Hall Distinguished Class and above, when awaiting replacement, must first prepare a sealed report on popular benefits and harms and submit it at the Gate Office before they may be granted audience."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingde, an edict restored the practice: "When ministers offer rotating audience, outer capital officials of Inner Hall Distinguished Class and above, when awaiting replacement, must first prepare a sealed report on popular benefits and harms and submit it at the Gate Office before they may be granted audience."

sentences.zh: 治平中，命御史臺每遇起居日，令百官轉對。

translations.literal: In the Zhiping era, the Censorate was ordered that on every audience day the myriad officials should offer rotating audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhiping era, the Censorate was ordered that on every audience day officials should offer rotating audience.

sentences.zh: 御史臺言：「舊制，起居日，輪兩省及文班秩高者二員轉對。

translations.literal: The Censorate said: "Under the old system, on audience days two officials of the two provinces and of the civil rank with the highest precedence offered rotating audience.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate reported: "Under the old system, on audience days two officials of the two provinces and of the civil rank with the highest precedence offered rotating audience.

sentences.zh: 若兩省宮有充學士、待制，則綴樞密班起居，內朝臣僚不與。」

translations.literal: If among officials of the two provinces some held concurrent posts as Academician or Attendant Draftsman, they joined the Military Affairs rank at audience; inner-court officials did not participate."
translations.idiomatic: If among officials of the two provinces some held concurrent posts as academician or attendant draftsman, they joined the Military Affairs rank at audience; inner-court officials did not participate."

sentences.zh: 尋詔遇轉對日，增二員。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward an edict ordered that on days of rotating audience two additional persons be added.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward an edict ordered that on days of rotating audience two additional persons be added.

sentences.zh: 熙寧初，閣門言：「舊制，中書省、樞密院奏事退，再引三班，假日則兩班，或再禦後殿引對，多及午刻，遇開經筵，即至申末，恐久勞聖躬。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining, the Gate Office said: "Under the old system, after the Central Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs finished reporting affairs, three ranks were again introduced; on holidays two ranks; or again the rear hall would receive audiences, often extending to the noon hour; when the classics lecture was opened it could reach late afternoon—we fear prolonged fatigue to the sacred person.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xining, the Gate Office reported: "Under the old system, after the Central Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs finished reporting affairs, three ranks were again introduced; on holidays two ranks; audiences in the rear hall often extended to noon; when the classics lecture was held they could last until late afternoon—we fear this would overtax Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 請遇經筵日，自二 府奏事外，止引一班，或有急奏及言事官請對即取旨，俟罷經筵日仍舊。」

translations.literal: We request that on days when the classics lecture is held, apart from reports from the Two Departments, only one rank be introduced; if there are urgent memorials or officials requesting audience, take instructions accordingly, and after the lecture day resume the former practice."
translations.idiomatic: We request that on days when the classics lecture is held, apart from reports from the Two Departments, only one rank be introduced; if there are urgent memorials or officials requesting audience, take instructions accordingly, and after the lecture day resume the former practice."

sentences.zh: 又言：「假日禦崇政殿，每遇辰時，則隔班過延和殿再引，不待進食，至巳刻隔班取旨， 尚許引對。

translations.literal: They also said: "On holidays when the Chongzheng Hall is used for audience, whenever the chen hour arrives one rank passes through Yanhe Hall and is introduced again without waiting for the meal; by the si hour, when ranks pass to receive instructions, audience is still permitted.
translations.idiomatic: They also reported: "On holidays when Chongzheng Hall is used for audience, whenever the chen hour arrives one rank passes through Yanhe Hall and is introduced again without waiting for the meal; by the si hour, when ranks pass to receive instructions, audience is still permitted.

sentences.zh: 請自今隔班過延和殿，俟已進食再引。

translations.literal: We request that from now on, when a rank passes through Yanhe Hall, introduction should wait until after the meal.
translations.idiomatic: We request that from now on, when a rank passes through Yanhe Hall, introduction should wait until after the meal has been taken.

sentences.zh: 遇寒暑、大風雨雪即令次日引對。」

translations.literal: In cases of cold, heat, great wind, rain, or snow, audience should be ordered for the next day."
translations.idiomatic: In cases of extreme cold, heat, high wind, rain, or snow, audience should be deferred to the next day."

sentences.zh: 詔：「自今授外任者許令轉對訖朝辭。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "From now on those receiving outer appointments are permitted to offer rotating audience and then take leave at audience."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "From now on those receiving outer appointments are permitted to offer rotating audience and then take leave at audience."

sentences.zh: 監察御史裏行張戩、程顥言：「每欲 奏事，必俟朝旨，或朝政有闕及聞外事而機速後時，則已無所及；

translations.literal: Investigating Censor-in-Training Zhang Jian and Cheng Hao said: "Whenever we wish to report affairs we must await court instruction; if there is a defect in court governance or news of outer affairs and the moment for swift action passes, then nothing can be done;
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor-in-Training Zhang Jian and Cheng Hao said: "Whenever we wish to report affairs we must await court instruction; if there is a defect in court governance or news from abroad and the moment for swift action passes, then nothing can be done;

sentences.zh: 況往復俟報，必由中書，萬一事幹政府，則或致阻格。

translations.literal: moreover, going back and forth awaiting reply must pass through the Central Secretariat; if by chance the matter touches the government, it may be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: moreover, going back and forth awaiting a reply must pass through the Central Secretariat; if by chance the matter touches the government, it may be blocked.

sentences.zh: 請依諫官例，牒閣門求對，或有急奏，即許 越次登對，庶幾遇事入告，無憂失時。」

translations.literal: We request that, following the remonstrance officials' precedent, we may notify the Gate Office to request audience; if there is an urgent memorial, crossing rank to ascend for audience should be permitted, so that when matters arise we may report in time without fear of missing the moment."
translations.idiomatic: We request that, following the remonstrance officials' precedent, we may notify the Gate Office to request audience; if there is an urgent memorial, we should be permitted to ascend for audience out of turn, so that when matters arise we may report in time without fear of missing the moment."

sentences.zh: 又以編修閣門儀製所言，三衙有急奏，許於後殿登對，若別有奏陳，則報閣門如常制，或假日禦崇政殿，則於已得旨對班後 續引，且許兩製以上同班奏事。

translations.literal: Again, according to those compiling the gate regulations, the Three Commands may ascend for audience in the rear hall if there is urgent business; if there is other business to report, they notify the Gate Office as in the regular system; or on holidays when the Chongzheng Hall is used for audience, after the rank that has received instructions has been introduced, further introduction continues, and officials of the Two Drafts and above in the same rank may report affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Again, according to those compiling the gate regulations, the Three Commands may ascend for audience in the rear hall when there is urgent business; for other reports they notify the Gate Office under the regular system; on holidays when Chongzheng Hall is used for audience, after the rank that has received instructions is introduced, further introduction continues, and officials of the Two Drafts and above in the same rank may report affairs.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，詔：「尚書侍郎同郎官一員奏事，郎中、員外郎番次隨之，不許獨留身。

translations.literal: In the Yuanfeng era, an edict said: "Vice Ministers of the Ministry report affairs together with one bureau official; Directors and Vice Directors follow in rotation and may not remain alone.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanfeng era, an edict stated: "Vice ministers of a ministry report affairs together with one bureau official; directors and vice directors follow in rotation and may not remain alone.

sentences.zh: 侍郎以下，亦不許獨請奏事。

translations.literal: Those below Vice Minister likewise may not request audience alone.
translations.idiomatic: Those below vice minister likewise may not request audience alone.

sentences.zh: 其左右 選非尚書通領者，聽侍郎以上郎官自隨。

translations.literal: For the left and right selection bureaus not under the general supervision of a ministry, Vice Ministers and above may have bureau officials follow as they choose.
translations.idiomatic: For the left and right selection bureaus not under the general supervision of a ministry, vice ministers and above may have bureau officials follow as they choose.

sentences.zh: 秘書、殿中省、諸寺監長官視尚書，貳丞以下視侍郎。」

translations.literal: Directors of the Secretariat, Palace Administration, and the various courts and directorates are treated like Ministers; deputies and assistants below are treated like Vice Ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Directors of the Secretariat, Palace Administration, and the various courts and directorates are treated like ministers; deputies and assistants below are treated like vice ministers."

sentences.zh: 又詔：「三省、樞密院獨班奏事日。

translations.literal: Again an edict said: "On days when the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs report affairs in separate ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "On days when the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs report affairs in separate ranks.

sentences.zh: 無得過三班。

translations.literal: No more than three ranks may pass.
translations.idiomatic: No more than three ranks may pass.

sentences.zh: 若三省俱獨班， 則樞密院當請奏事。

translations.literal: If all Three Departments report in separate ranks, the Bureau of Military Affairs should request to report affairs.
translations.idiomatic: If all three departments report in separate ranks, the Bureau of Military Affairs should request to report affairs.

sentences.zh: 其見任官召對訖，次日即朝辭回任聽旨。」

translations.literal: For incumbent officials summoned for audience, on the next day they take leave at audience and return to their posts to await instructions."
translations.idiomatic: For incumbent officials summoned for audience, on the next day they take leave at audience and return to their posts to await instructions."

sentences.zh: 元祐中，宰臣呂大防言：「昨垂簾聽政，惟許台諫以二人同對，故不正之言無得以入。

translations.literal: In the Yuanyou era, Chief Counselor Lü Dafang said: "Yesterday, during regency behind the curtain, only the remonstrance and censor officials were permitted to report two together, so improper words could not enter.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanyou era, Chief Counselor Lü Dafang said: "Yesterday, during regency behind the curtain, only remonstrance and censor officials were permitted to report two together, so improper words could not enter.

sentences.zh: 今陛下初見群臣，請對者必眾。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty is first meeting the host of ministers, and those requesting audience will certainly be numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty is first meeting the host of ministers, and those requesting audience will certainly be numerous.

sentences.zh: 既人人得進，則善惡相雜，故於采納尤難。」

translations.literal: Since everyone may advance, good and evil are mixed together, so adoption is especially difficult."
translations.idiomatic: Since everyone may advance, good and evil are mixed together, making it especially difficult to adopt sound counsel."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「人君以納諫為上，然邪正則不可不辨。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "For a ruler, receiving remonstrance is paramount, yet the wicked and the upright cannot go un distinguished."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "For a ruler, receiving remonstrance is paramount, yet the wicked and the upright cannot go undistinguished."

sentences.zh: 遂詔上殿班當直牒及帥臣、國信使副，許依元豐八年以前儀製。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered that those on duty at the upper-hall rank, military commanders, and deputy envoys of credentials might follow the regulations before the eighth year of Yuanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict ordered that those on duty at the upper-hall rank, military commanders, and deputy envoys of credentials might follow the regulations before the eighth year of Yuanfeng.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，臣僚言：「文德殿視朝輪官轉對，蓋襲唐制，故祖宗以來，每遇轉對，侍從之臣亦皆與焉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaosheng, a subject said: "At Wende Hall audience officials rotate in turn—this follows the Tang system; therefore since the founding ancestors, whenever there was rotating audience, attendant ministers also all participated.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Shaosheng, a subject said: "At Wende Hall audience officials rotate in turn—this follows the Tang system; therefore since the founding ancestors, whenever there was rotating audience, attendant ministers also participated.

sentences.zh: 元祐間因言者免侍從官轉對，續詔職事官權侍郎以上並免，自 此轉對止於卿、監、郎官而已。

translations.literal: In the Yuanyou era, because remonstrators exempted attendant ministers from rotating audience, a subsequent edict also exempted functional officials acting as Vice Ministers and above; from then on rotating audience was limited to directors, supervisors, and bureau officials only.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanyou era, because remonstrators exempted attendant ministers from rotating audience, a subsequent edict also exempted functional officials acting as vice ministers and above; from then on rotating audience was limited to directors, supervisors, and bureau officials only.

sentences.zh: 請自今視朝轉對依元豐以前條製。」

translations.literal: We request that from now on audience rotation follow the regulations before Yuanfeng."
translations.idiomatic: We request that from now on audience rotation follow the regulations before Yuanfeng."

sentences.zh: 又詔：「自今三省、樞密院進擬在京文臣開封府推判官、武臣橫行使副、在外文臣諸路監司藩郡 知州、武臣知州軍已上，取旨召對。」

translations.literal: Again an edict said: "From now on the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs, when nominating civil officials in the capital such as Push Judges of Kaifeng Prefecture, military officials such as deputy envoys of the horizontal commission, civil officials outside the capital such as circuit supervisors and prefects of feudatory commanderies, and military officials such as prefects of prefectures and armies and above, shall seek instructions and summon for audience."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "From now on the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs, when nominating civil officials in the capital such as push judges of Kaifeng Prefecture, military officials such as deputy envoys of the horizontal commission, civil officials outside the capital such as circuit supervisors and prefects of feudatory commanderies, and military officials such as prefects of prefectures and armies and above, shall seek instructions and summon them for audience."

sentences.zh: 臣僚言：「每緣職事請對，待次旬日，遇有急奏，深恐失事。

translations.literal: A subject said: "Whenever one requests audience on official business, one waits in queue for ten days; if there is urgent business, we deeply fear missing the moment.
translations.idiomatic: A subject said: "Whenever one requests audience on official business, one waits in queue for ten days; if there is urgent business, we deeply fear missing the moment.

sentences.zh: 請自今後許依六曹、開封例，先次挑班上殿，仍不隔班。」

translations.literal: We request that hereafter permission be granted, following the precedent of the Six Ministries and Kaifeng, to advance first in rank to ascend the hall, and still without separating ranks."
translations.idiomatic: We request that hereafter permission be granted, following the precedent of the Six Ministries and Kaifeng, to advance first in rank to ascend the hall, and still without separating ranks."

sentences.zh: 又 言：「諸路監司，朝廷所選，以推行法令，省問風俗，朝辭之日，當令上殿。」

translations.literal: They also said: "Circuit supervisors are chosen by the court to enforce laws and ordinances and to inquire into local customs; on the day of audience leave they should be ordered to ascend the hall."
translations.idiomatic: They also said: "Circuit supervisors are chosen by the court to enforce laws and ordinances and to inquire into local customs; on the day of audience leave they should be ordered to ascend the hall."

sentences.zh: 六曹尚書如有職事奏陳，許獨員上殿。

translations.literal: Ministers of the Six Ministries, if they have official business to report, are permitted to ascend the hall alone.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers of the Six Ministries, if they have official business to report, are permitted to ascend the hall alone.

sentences.zh: 其群臣請對，雖遇休假，特禦便殿聽納。

translations.literal: When the host of ministers requests audience, even if it falls on a holiday, the Emperor specially holds audience in the convenient hall to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: When ministers request audience, even on a holiday, the Emperor specially holds audience in the convenient hall to receive them.

sentences.zh: 既又 詔：「應節鎮郡守往令陛辭，歸許登對，不特審觀人材，亦所以重外任也。

translations.literal: Again an edict said: "Formerly military commissioners and prefects were ordered to take leave at audience; on return they were permitted to ascend for audience—not only to examine personnel, but also to show weight to outer appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Again an edict stated: "Formerly military commissioners and prefects were ordered to take leave at audience; on return they were permitted to ascend for audience—not only to examine personnel, but also to show the weight given to outer appointments.

sentences.zh: 可於監司不許免對條下，增入節鎮郡守依此。」

translations.literal: Under the article that circuit supervisors may not be exempt from audience, add military commissioners and prefects following this rule."
translations.idiomatic: Under the article that circuit supervisors may not be exempt from audience, add military commissioners and prefects following this rule."

sentences.zh: 重和元年，臣僚言：「比年以來，二三大臣奏對留身，讒疏善良，請求相繼，甚非至公之體。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Chonghe, officials said: "In recent years, major ministers reporting at audience have remained behind alone, slandering the virtuous in succession and making requests one after another—this is far from the standard of utmost fairness."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chonghe, officials said: "In recent years, major ministers reporting at audience have remained behind alone, slandering the virtuous in succession and making requests one after another—this is far from the standard of utmost fairness."

sentences.zh: 詔：「自今惟蔡京五日一朝許留身，餘非除拜、遷秩、因謝及陳乞免罷，並不許獨班奏事，令閣門報御史臺彈劾。」

translations.literal: An edict stated: "From now on only Cai Jing, on his once-every-five-days court appearance, is permitted to remain behind alone; except for appointments, promotions, thanks for appointment, and petitions to be excused or dismissed, none are permitted to report affairs in a separate rank; the Gate Office is ordered to report them to the Censorate for impeachment."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "From now on only Cai Jing, on his once-every-five-days court appearance, is permitted to remain behind alone; except for appointments, promotions, thanks for appointment, and petitions to be excused or dismissed, none are permitted to report affairs in a separate rank; the Gate Office is ordered to report them to the Censorate for impeachment."

sentences.zh: 又詔：「寺監職事上部，部上省，故得上下維持，綱紀所出。

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "The duties of the courts and directorates belong to their ministries, and the ministries belong to their departments; thus upper and lower could be maintained and discipline preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "The duties of the courts and directorates belong to their ministries, and the ministries belong to their departments; thus upper and lower could be maintained and discipline preserved.

sentences.zh: 今後雖係兩製，職司寺監不許獨對。」

translations.literal: From now on, even if they belong to both offices, officials of the courts and directorates are not permitted audience alone."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, even if they belong to both offices, officials of the courts and directorates are not permitted audience alone."

sentences.zh: 臣僚言：「祖宗舊制，有五日一轉對者，今惟月朔行之，有許朝官轉對者，今惟待制以上預焉。

translations.literal: Officials said: "Under the ancestral system, there were rotating audiences every five days, but now this is conducted only at the new moon; those permitted rotating audience among court officials now include only attendant draftsmen and above.
translations.idiomatic: Officials said: "Under the ancestral system, there were rotating audiences every five days, but now this is conducted only at the new moon; those permitted rotating audience among court officials now include only attendant draftsmen and above.

sentences.zh: 自明堂行視朔禮，歲不過一再，則是畢歲而論思者無幾。

translations.literal: Since the Bright Hall rite for viewing the new moon was instituted, the year rarely sees it more than once or twice, so in a whole year there are scarcely any occasions for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Bright Hall rite for viewing the new moon was instituted, the year rarely sees it more than once or twice, so in a whole year there are scarcely any occasions for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 請遇不視朔，即令具章投進，以備覽觀。」

translations.literal: We request that when the new moon is not viewed, officials be ordered to submit written memorials for the Emperor's review."
translations.idiomatic: We request that when the new moon is not viewed, officials be ordered to submit written memorials for the Emperor's review."

sentences.zh: 又：「諸路監司未經上殿者，雖從外移，先赴闕引對，方得之官。」

translations.literal: Moreover: "Circuit supervisors who have not yet ascended the hall, even if transferred from another post, must first come to court for audience before receiving appointment."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover: "Circuit supervisors who have not yet ascended the hall, even if transferred from another post, must first come to court for audience before receiving appointment."

sentences.zh: 並從其議。

translations.literal: Both proposals were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 百官相見儀製。

translations.literal: Regulations for officials meeting one another.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for how officials greet one another.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年，詔曰：「國家職位肇分，軌儀有序，冀等威之斯辨，在 品式之惟明。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiande, an edict said: "The state's offices were first divided and ritual order arranged, hoping that distinctions of rank and authority would be clear and grades and patterns made plain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qiande, an edict declared: "The state's offices were first divided and ritual order arranged, so that distinctions of rank and authority would be clear and grades and patterns made plain.

sentences.zh: 矧著位之庶官及內司之諸使，以至軒墀引籍，州縣命官，凡進見於宰相，或參候於長吏，既為總攝，合異禮容，稽於舊儀，且無定法。

translations.literal: How much more for officials holding established posts and the various commissioners of the inner service, down to those led in at the hall balustrade and appointees of prefectures and counties—whenever they go in to see the chief counselor or call on a superior official, since they are under general supervision, different ritual bearing is fitting; on examining old ritual, there was as yet no fixed law.
translations.idiomatic: How much more for officials holding established posts and the various commissioners of the inner service, down to those presented at the hall balustrade and appointees of prefectures and counties—whenever they go in to see the chief counselor or call on a superior official, since they are under general supervision, a different ritual bearing is fitting; on examining old ritual, there was as yet no fixed law.

sentences.zh: 或傳晉天福、周 顯德中，以廷臣、內職、賓從、將校，比其品數，著為綱條，載於刑統，未為詳悉。

translations.literal: It is said that in the Tianfu era of Jin and the Xiande era of Zhou, court ministers, inner service, guests and followers, and generals and officers were compared by grade and set forth as guidelines, recorded in the penal code, but not in full detail.
translations.idiomatic: It is said that in the Tianfu era of Jin and the Xiande era of Zhou, court ministers, inner-service officials, guests and followers, and generals and officers were compared by grade and set forth as guidelines, recorded in the penal code, but not in full detail.

sentences.zh: 宜令尚書省集台省官、翰林、秘書、國子司業、太常博士等詳定內外群臣相見之 儀。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to order the Department of State Affairs to assemble officials of the central platform, Hanlin, Secretariat, Director of Education, Doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others to fix in detail the ritual for inner and outer officials meeting one another."
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to order the Department of State Affairs to assemble officials of the central platform, Hanlin, Secretariat, director of education, doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others to fix in detail the ritual for inner and outer officials meeting one another."

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨陶穀等奏：

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician and Drafter-in-Chief Tao Gu and others memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician and Drafter-in-Chief Tao Gu and others memorialized:

sentences.zh: 兩省官除授、假使出入，並參宰相，起居郎以下參同舍人。

translations.literal: Officials of the two provinces, on appointment, temporary assignment, or going out and in, all call on the chief counselor; Attendant Gentlemen and below call on their colleagues in the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the two provinces, on appointment, temporary assignment, or going out and in, all call on the chief counselor; attendant gentlemen and below call on their colleagues in the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五品以上官，遇於途，斂馬側立，須其過。

translations.literal: Officials of the fifth rank and above, when meeting on the road, rein in the horse and stand to the side, waiting until the other has passed.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the fifth rank and above, when meeting on the road, rein in the horse and stand to the side, waiting until the other has passed.

sentences.zh: 常 侍以下遇三公、三師、尚書令，引避；

translations.literal: Regular Attendants and below, when meeting the Three Excellencies, Three Preceptors, or Director of Affairs, draw aside;
translations.idiomatic: Regular attendants and below, when meeting the three excellencies, three preceptors, or director of affairs, draw aside;

sentences.zh: 其值僕射，斂馬側立。

translations.literal: when meeting the Vice Grand Counselor, they rein in the horse and stand to the side.
translations.idiomatic: when meeting the vice grand counselor, they rein in the horse and stand to the side.

sentences.zh: 御史夫夫、中丞皆分路行。

translations.literal: The Censor-in-Chief and Vice Censor-in-Chief all travel by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: The censor-in-chief and vice censor-in-chief all travel by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 起居郎以下避僕射，遇大夫，斂馬側立；

translations.literal: Attendant Gentlemen and below avoid the Vice Grand Counselor; when meeting the Censor-in-Chief, they rein in the horse and stand to the side;
translations.idiomatic: Attendant gentlemen and below avoid the vice grand counselor; when meeting the censor-in-chief, they rein in the horse and stand to the side;

sentences.zh: 中丞，分路。

translations.literal: the Vice Censor-in-Chief travels by a separate route.
translations.idiomatic: the vice censor-in-chief travels by a separate route.

sentences.zh: 尚書丞郎、郎中、員 外並參三師、三公、令、仆，郎中、員外兼參左右丞、本行尚書、侍郎及本轄左右司郎中、員外。

translations.literal: Assistants and Directors of the Ministry, Directors and Vice Directors, all call on the Three Preceptors, Three Excellencies, Director, and Vice Grand Counselor; Directors and Vice Directors also call on the Left and Right Vice Ministers, the Minister and Vice Minister of their own ministry, and the Left and Right Bureau Directors and Vice Directors of their jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Assistants and directors of the ministry, directors and vice directors, all call on the three preceptors, three excellencies, director, and vice grand counselor; directors and vice directors also call on the left and right vice ministers, the minister and vice minister of their own ministry, and the left and right bureau directors and vice directors of their jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫以下參三師、三公、尚書令，中丞兼參大夫，知雜事參中 丞，三院御史兼參知雜及本院之長。

translations.literal: From Censor-in-Chief downward all call on the Three Preceptors, Three Excellencies, and Director of Affairs; the Vice Censor-in-Chief also calls on the Censor-in-Chief; the Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs also calls on the Vice Censor-in-Chief; censors of the three bureaus also call on the Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs and the head of their own bureau.
translations.idiomatic: From censor-in-chief downward all call on the three preceptors, three excellencies, and director of affairs; the vice censor-in-chief also calls on the censor-in-chief; the supervisor of miscellaneous affairs also calls on the vice censor-in-chief; censors of the three bureaus also call on the supervisor of miscellaneous affairs and the head of their own bureau.

sentences.zh: 大夫避尚書令以上，遇僕射，斂馬側立而避。

translations.literal: The Censor-in-Chief avoids those from the Director of Affairs upward; when meeting the Vice Grand Counselor, he reins in the horse, stands to the side, and avoids.
translations.idiomatic: The censor-in-chief avoids those from the director of affairs upward; when meeting the vice grand counselor, he reins in the horse, stands to the side, and avoids.

sentences.zh: 大夫遇尚書丞郎、兩省官諸司三品以上、金吾大將軍、統軍上將軍，皆分路。

translations.literal: When the Censor-in-Chief meets Assistants and Directors of the Ministry, officials of the two provinces of the third rank and above, the Golden Crow Grand General, and the Commander-in-Chief of the Army, all travel by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: When the censor-in-chief meets assistants and directors of the ministry, officials of the two provinces of the third rank and above, the Golden Crow grand general, and the commander-in-chief of the army, all travel by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 餘官 遇中丞，悉引避。

translations.literal: All remaining officials, when meeting the Vice Censor-in-Chief, all draw aside.
translations.idiomatic: All remaining officials, when meeting the vice censor-in-chief, all draw aside.

sentences.zh: 知雜兼避中丞，遇左右丞斂馬側立，餘皆分路。

translations.literal: The Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs, when also avoiding the Vice Censor-in-Chief, when meeting the Left and Right Vice Ministers reins in the horse and stands to the side; all others travel by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: The supervisor of miscellaneous affairs, when also avoiding the vice censor-in-chief, when meeting the left and right vice ministers reins in the horse and stands aside; all others take separate routes.

sentences.zh: 郎中及少卿監、大將軍以下，皆避知雜。

translations.literal: Directors and Junior Directors of courts and directorates, Grand Generals and below, all avoid the Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Directors and junior directors of courts and directorates, grand generals and below, all avoid the supervisor of miscellaneous affairs.

sentences.zh: 三院同行，如知雜之例。

translations.literal: When the three bureaus travel together, they follow the precedent of the Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the three bureaus travel together, they follow the supervisor of miscellaneous affairs' precedent.

sentences.zh: 少卿監並參本司長官，丞參少 卿。

translations.literal: Junior Directors all call on the director of their own office; assistants call on the Junior Director.
translations.idiomatic: Junior directors all call on the director of their own office; assistants call on the junior director.

sentences.zh: 諸司三品遇僕射於途，皆引避。

translations.literal: Third-rank officials of the various offices, when meeting the Vice Grand Counselor on the road, all draw aside.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officials of the various offices, when meeting the vice grand counselor on the road, all draw aside.

sentences.zh: 諸衛大將軍參本衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Grand Generals of the various guards call on the Superior General of their own guard.
translations.idiomatic: Grand generals of the various guards call on the superior general of their own guard.

sentences.zh: 東宮官參隔品。

translations.literal: Eastern Palace officials call on those one grade apart.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Palace officials call on those one grade apart.

sentences.zh: 凡參者若遇於途，皆避。

translations.literal: Whenever those who call on one another meet on the road, all avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever officials who call on one another meet on the road, all observe avoidance.

sentences.zh: 公參之禮，列拜堂上，位高受參者答焉。

translations.literal: The ritual of public calling: they arrange bows in the hall; the higher in rank receives the call, and the caller responds.
translations.idiomatic: In the ritual of public calling, they arrange bows in the hall; the higher-ranking official receives the call and the caller responds.

sentences.zh: 四赤 縣令初見尹，趨庭，受拜後升廳如客禮。

translations.literal: Magistrates of the Four Scarlet Counties, on first meeting the Governor, hurry into the courtyard; after receiving the bow they ascend the hall with the ritual of a guest.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates of the Four Scarlet Counties, on first meeting the governor, hurry into the courtyard; after receiving the bow they ascend the hall with guest ritual.

sentences.zh: 內客省使謁宰相、樞密使以客禮，閣門使以上列拜，皆答，客省副使至通事舍人、諸司使、樞密承旨不答焉。

translations.literal: Commissioners of the Inner Guests Bureau call on the chief counselor and Commissioner of Military Affairs with guest ritual; from Gate Commissioner upward they arrange bows in rank and all are answered; Deputy Commissioners of the Guests Bureau down to Herald Master, commissioners of the various offices, and Military Affairs Drafter-in-Chief are not answered.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners of the Inner Guests Bureau call on the chief counselor and commissioner of military affairs with guest ritual; from gate commissioner upward they arrange bows in rank and all receive a response; deputy commissioners of the guests bureau down to the herald master, commissioners of the various offices, and the military affairs drafter-in-chief receive no response.

sentences.zh: 自樞密使副、 宣徽使皆差降其禮，供奉官、殿直、教坊使副、辭令官、伎術官並趨庭，倨受。

translations.literal: From Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs and Commissioner of the Palace Directorate downward their ritual is progressively reduced; supply officials, palace attendants, deputy commissioners of the Music Office, masters of ceremony, and technical officials all hurry into the courtyard and receive bows while standing aloof.
translations.idiomatic: From the deputy commissioner of military affairs and commissioner of the palace directorate downward their ritual is progressively reduced; supply officials, palace attendants, deputy commissioners of the music office, masters of ceremony, and technical officials all hurry into the courtyard and receive bows while standing aloof.

sentences.zh: 諸司副使參大使，通事舍人參閣門使，防禦、團練、刺史謁本道節帥，節度、防禦、 團練副使謁本使，並具軍容趨庭，延以客禮。

translations.literal: Deputy commissioners of the various offices call on the chief commissioner; Herald Masters call on the Gate Commissioner; Defense and Training Commissioners and Prefects call on the military commissioner of their circuit; Deputy Military, Defense, and Training Commissioners call on their own commissioner—all with full military bearing hurry into the courtyard and are received with guest ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commissioners of the various offices call on the chief commissioner; herald masters call on the gate commissioner; defense and training commissioners and prefects call on the military commissioner of their circuit; deputy military, defense, and training commissioners call on their own commissioner—all with full military bearing hurry into the courtyard and are received with guest ritual.

sentences.zh: 少尹、幕府於本院長官悉拜。

translations.literal: Junior Governors and staff of the administrative commission all bow to the director of their own office.
translations.idiomatic: Junior governors and staff of the administrative commission all bow to the director of their own office.

sentences.zh: 防禦、團練判官謁本道節帥，並趨庭。

translations.literal: Defense and Training Judge-Advocates call on the military commissioner of their circuit and all hurry into the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Defense and training judge-advocates call on the military commissioner of their circuit and all hurry into the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 上佐、州縣官見宰相、樞密使及本屬長官，並拜於 庭

translations.literal: Senior administrators and prefectural and county officials, when meeting the chief counselor, Commissioner of Military Affairs, and their own superior officials, all bow in the courtyard
translations.idiomatic: Senior administrators and prefectural and county officials, when meeting the chief counselor, commissioner of military affairs, and their own superior officials, all bow in the courtyard

sentences.zh: 〈（天長、雄武等軍使見宰相、樞密亦知之）〉。

translations.literal: (Commissioners of armies such as Tianchang and Xiongwu, when meeting the chief counselor and Military Affairs, are treated likewise)
translations.idiomatic: (Commissioners of armies such as Tianchang and Xiongwu, when meeting the chief counselor and Military Affairs, are treated likewise)

sentences.zh: 參本府賓幕官及曹掾，縣簿、尉參令，皆拜。

translations.literal: Staff of one's own prefecture and administrative assistants, county registrars and assistants calling on the magistrate, all bow.
translations.idiomatic: Staff of one's own prefecture and administrative assistants, county registrars and assistants calling on the magistrate, all bow.

sentences.zh: 王府官見親王如賓職見使長，府縣官兼三館職者見大尹同。

translations.literal: Officials of princes' households, when meeting an imperial prince, are like guest staff meeting a commissioner; prefectural and county officials who concurrently hold Three Institutes posts, when meeting the metropolitan governor, follow the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of princes' households, when meeting an imperial prince, follow the same etiquette as guest staff meeting a commissioner; prefectural and county officials who concurrently hold Three Institutes posts follow the same rule when meeting the metropolitan governor.

sentences.zh: 赤縣令、六 品以下未嘗參官，見宰相、樞密及本司長官，並拜階上。

translations.literal: Magistrates of Scarlet Counties and officials of the sixth rank and below who have never called, when meeting the chief counselor, Military Affairs, and the director of their own office, all bow on the steps.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates of scarlet counties and officials of the sixth rank and below who have never called, when meeting the chief counselor, Military Affairs, and the director of their own office, all bow on the steps.

sentences.zh: 流外見流內品官，並趨庭。

translations.literal: Those outside the regular roster, when meeting officials within the roster by rank, all hurry into the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Those outside the regular roster, when meeting officials within the roster by rank, all hurry into the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 諸司非相統攝，皆稱移牒。

translations.literal: Offices not under mutual supervision all address one another by official memorandum.
translations.idiomatic: Offices not under mutual supervision all address one another by official memorandum.

sentences.zh: 分路者不得籠街及占中道，依秩序以分左右。

translations.literal: Those traveling by separate routes may not block the street or occupy the middle of the road; according to order they take left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Those traveling by separate routes may not block the street or occupy the middle of the road; according to order they take the left and right sides.

sentences.zh: 遇於驛舍，非相統攝及名位縣隔，先至者居之。

translations.literal: When meeting at a post station, if not under mutual supervision and if names and ranks are far apart, whoever arrives first occupies it.
translations.idiomatic: When meeting at a post station, if not under mutual supervision and if names and ranks are far apart, whoever arrives first occupies it.

sentences.zh: 台省官當通官嗬止者，如舊式。

translations.literal: For Censorate and Secretariat officials who should call out to halt passing officials, follow the old form.
translations.idiomatic: For censorate and secretariat officials who should call out to halt passing officials, follow the old form.

sentences.zh: 文武官不得假借呼稱，以紊朝製。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials may not borrow and use titles of address, lest court regulations be confused.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials may not borrow and use improper titles of address, lest court regulations be confused.

sentences.zh: 當避路者，若被宣召及有所捕逐，許橫度焉。

translations.literal: Those who should avoid on the road, if summoned by edict or engaged in pursuit and capture, are permitted to cross athwart.
translations.idiomatic: Those who should avoid on the road, if summoned by edict or engaged in pursuit and capture, are permitted to cross the road directly.

sentences.zh: 又令：「諸司使、副使、通事舍人見宰相、樞密使，升階、連姓通名展拜，不答拜。

translations.literal: Again an order said: "Commissioners, Deputy Commissioners, and Herald Masters of the various offices, when meeting the chief counselor and Commissioner of Military Affairs, ascend the steps, announce their full surname and given name in rank, and perform the extended bow; no bow in return is given.
translations.idiomatic: Another order stated: "Commissioners, deputy commissioners, and herald masters of the various offices, when meeting the chief counselor and commissioner of military affairs, ascend the steps, announce their full surname and given name in rank, and perform the extended bow; no bow in return is given.

sentences.zh: 其見樞密副使、參知政事、宣徽使，以客禮展拜。」

translations.literal: When meeting the Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs, Participant in Governance, or Commissioner of the Palace Directorate, they use guest ritual and perform the extended bow."
translations.idiomatic: When meeting the deputy commissioner of military affairs, participant in governance, or commissioner of the palace directorate, they use guest ritual and perform the extended bow."

sentences.zh: 太平興國以後，又製京朝官知令錄者，見本使州長吏以客禮，三司判官、推官、主判官見本如郎中、員外見尚書丞郎之儀。

translations.literal: After Taiping Xingguo, regulations were also made that capital officials serving as magistrates and registrars, when meeting the military commissioner and prefect of their circuit, used guest ritual; judges, push officials, and chief judges of the Three Commissions, when meeting their own superiors, followed the ritual of Directors and Vice Directors calling on Ministry Assistants and Directors.
translations.idiomatic: After Taiping Xingguo, regulations were also made that capital officials serving as magistrates and registrars, when meeting the military commissioner and prefect of their circuit, used guest ritual; judges, push officials, and chief judges of the Three Commissions, when meeting their own superiors, followed the ritual of directors and vice directors calling on ministry assistants and directors.

sentences.zh: 咸平中，又詔：開封府左右軍巡使、京官知司錄及諸曹參軍到畿縣見京尹，並趨庭設拜。

translations.literal: In the Xianping era, an edict also ordered: Military Patrol Commissioners of the left and right of Kaifeng Prefecture, capital officials serving as registrar and the various bureau military commissioners, when arriving at capital counties and meeting the metropolitan governor, all hurry into the courtyard and perform the bow.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xianping era, an edict also ordered that military patrol commissioners of the left and right of Kaifeng Prefecture, capital officials serving as registrar and the various bureau military commissioners, when arriving at capital counties and meeting the metropolitan governor, all hurry into the courtyard and perform the bow.

sentences.zh: 六年，命翰林學士梁顥等詳定閣門儀製，成六卷，因上言：「三司副使序 班、朝服比品素無定列，至道中，筵會在知制誥後、郎中前。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Hanlin Academician Liang Hao and others were ordered to fix the gate regulations in detail, completing six scrolls, and memorialized: "Deputy Commissioners of the Three Commissions have no fixed rank order or court dress by grade; in the Zhidao era at banquets they were after Drafters-in-Chief and before Directors.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Hanlin Academician Liang Hao and others were ordered to fix the gate regulations in detail, completing six scrolls, and reported: "Deputy commissioners of the Three Commissions have no fixed rank order or court dress by grade; in the Zhidao era at banquets they stood after drafters-in-chief and before directors.

sentences.zh: 今請同諸司、少卿監，班位在上。

translations.literal: We now request that they follow the various offices and Junior Directors of courts, with rank position above.
translations.idiomatic: We now request that they follow the various offices and junior directors of courts, with rank position above.

sentences.zh: 如官至給諫、卿監者，自如本品，朝會大宴隨判使赴長春殿起居引 駕。

translations.literal: If rank reaches Supervising Drafter, Remonstrance Official, or Director of a Court, they follow their own grade; at court audience and great banquets they follow the chief commissioner to Changchun Hall for audience and to lead the imperial procession.
translations.idiomatic: If rank reaches supervising drafter, remonstrance official, or director of a court, they follow their own grade; at court audience and great banquets they follow the chief commissioner to Changchun Hall for audience and to lead the imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 其朝會引駕至前殿，與諸司使同退。」

translations.literal: At court audience, when leading the procession to the front hall, they withdraw together with commissioners of the various offices."
translations.idiomatic: At court audience, when leading the procession to the front hall, they withdraw together with commissioners of the various offices."

sentences.zh: 大中祥符五年，復命翰林學士李宗諤等詳定儀製：文武百官遇宰相、樞密使、參知政事，並避。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Hanlin Academician Li Zong'e and others were again ordered to fix the regulations in detail: when civil and military officials of the myriad ranks meet the chief counselor, Commissioner of Military Affairs, or Participant in Governance, all avoid.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Hanlin Academician Li Zong'e and others were again ordered to fix the regulations in detail: when civil and military officials of the myriad ranks meet the chief counselor, commissioner of military affairs, or participant in governance, all avoid.

sentences.zh: 起居郎以下 遇給、舍以上，斂馬。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentlemen and below, when meeting Supervising Drafters and above, rein in the horse.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant gentlemen and below, when meeting supervising drafters and above, rein in the horse.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫遇東宮三師、尚書丞郎、兩省侍郎，分路而行。

translations.literal: The Censor-in-Chief, when meeting the Three Preceptors of the Eastern Palace, Ministry Assistants and Directors, and Vice Ministers of the two provinces, travels by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: The censor-in-chief, when meeting the three preceptors of the Eastern Palace, ministry assistants and directors, and vice ministers of the two provinces, travels by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 中丞遇三師、三少、太常卿、金吾上將軍，並分路而行。

translations.literal: The Vice Censor-in-Chief, when meeting the Three Preceptors, Three Juniors, Minister of Rites, and Golden Crow Superior General, all travels by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: The vice censor-in-chief, when meeting the three preceptors, three juniors, minister of rites, and Golden Crow superior general, all travels by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 知雜御史遇尚書侍郎、諸司 三品、金吾大將軍、統軍、諸衛上將軍，分路而行。

translations.literal: The Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs, when meeting Vice Ministers of the Ministry, third-rank officials of the various offices, Golden Crow Grand General, Commander-in-Chief, and Superior Generals of the various guards, travels by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: The supervisor of miscellaneous affairs, when meeting vice ministers of the ministry, third-rank officials of the various offices, Golden Crow grand general, commander-in-chief, and superior generals of the various guards, travels by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 三院同行如知雜例，不同行，遇左右丞則避。

translations.literal: When the three bureaus travel together they follow the Supervisor's precedent; when not traveling together, when meeting the Left and Right Vice Ministers they avoid.
translations.idiomatic: When the three bureaus travel together they follow the supervisor's precedent; when not traveling together, when meeting the left and right vice ministers they avoid.

sentences.zh: 尚書丞郎、郎中、員外遇三師、三公、尚書令，則避。

translations.literal: Ministry Assistants and Directors, Directors and Vice Directors, when meeting the Three Preceptors, Three Excellencies, and Director of Affairs, avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry assistants and directors, directors and vice directors, when meeting the three preceptors, three excellencies, and director of affairs, avoid.

sentences.zh: 郎中、員外 遇丞郎，則避。

translations.literal: Directors and Vice Directors, when meeting Assistants and Directors, avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Directors and vice directors, when meeting assistants and directors, avoid.

sentences.zh: 太常博士以下朝官遇本司長官、三師、三公、僕射、尚書丞郎、大夫、中丞、知雜御史，並避，權知判者不避，遇兩省給舍以上，斂馬。

translations.literal: Doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and court officials below, when meeting the director of their own office, the Three Preceptors, Three Excellencies, Vice Grand Counselor, Ministry Assistants and Directors, Censor-in-Chief, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Supervisor of Miscellaneous Affairs, all avoid; acting directors do not avoid; when meeting Supervising Drafters and above of the two provinces, they rein in the horse.
translations.idiomatic: Doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and court officials below, when meeting the director of their own office, the three preceptors, three excellencies, vice grand counselor, ministry assistants and directors, censor-in-chief, vice censor-in-chief, and supervisor of miscellaneous affairs, all avoid; acting directors do not avoid; when meeting supervising drafters and above of the two provinces, they rein in the horse.

sentences.zh: 京官遇丞 郎、給舍、大卿監、祭酒以上及本寺少監卿、司業，並避。

translations.literal: Capital officials, when meeting Assistants and Directors, Supervising Drafters, Grand Directors of courts, Director of Education, and above, and the Junior Director and Director of their own court, Vice Director of Education, all avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials, when meeting assistants and directors, supervising drafters, grand directors of courts, director of education, and above, and the junior director and director of their own court, vice director of education, all avoid.

sentences.zh: 諸軍衛大將軍以下遇上將軍、統軍，亦避。

translations.literal: Grand Generals of the various guards and below, when meeting Superior Generals and Commanders-in-Chief, also avoid.
