translations.idiomatic: Grand generals of the various guards and below, when meeting superior generals and commanders-in-chief, also avoid.

sentences.zh: 詹事遇上台官，如卿監之例。

translations.literal: The Grand Steward, when meeting upper-platform officials, follows the precedent of directors of courts.
translations.idiomatic: The grand steward, when meeting upper-platform officials, follows the precedent of directors of courts.

sentences.zh: 庶子、少詹事至太子仆遇東宮三 師、三少，並避；

translations.literal: Subordinates, Junior Grand Steward down to Masters of the Eastern Palace, when meeting the Three Preceptors and Three Juniors of the Eastern Palace, all avoid;
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates, junior grand steward down to masters of the Eastern Palace, when meeting the three preceptors and three juniors of the Eastern Palace, all avoid;

sentences.zh: 遇上台官，如少卿監例。

translations.literal: when meeting upper-platform officials, follow the precedent of Junior Directors.
translations.idiomatic: when meeting upper-platform officials, they follow the precedent of junior directors.

sentences.zh: 中允以下遇東宮三師、三少，並避；

translations.literal: Junior Attachés and below, when meeting the Three Preceptors and Three Juniors of the Eastern Palace, all avoid;
translations.idiomatic: Junior attachés and below, when meeting the three preceptors and three juniors of the Eastern Palace, all avoid;

sentences.zh: 遇賓客、詹事，斂馬；

translations.literal: when meeting the Guest and Grand Steward, rein in the horse;
translations.idiomatic: when meeting the guest and grand steward, they rein in the horse;

sentences.zh: 遇上台官，如太常博士例。

translations.literal: when meeting upper-platform officials, follow the precedent of Doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: when meeting upper-platform officials, they follow the precedent of doctors of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 應合避尚書者，並避三司使。

translations.literal: Those who should avoid the Ministry Director all avoid the Three Commissions Commissioner as well.
translations.idiomatic: Those who should avoid the ministry director all avoid the Three Commissions commissioner as well.

sentences.zh: 其權 知開封府如本官品避。

translations.literal: Those acting as metropolitan governor of Kaifeng follow avoidance according to their substantive grade.
translations.idiomatic: Those acting as metropolitan governor of Kaifeng follow avoidance according to their substantive grade.

sentences.zh: 其台省官雖不合避，而職在統臨者，並避。

translations.literal: Censorate and Secretariat officials who should not avoid, but whose duties involve supervision, all avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate and secretariat officials who should not avoid, but whose duties involve supervision, all avoid.

sentences.zh: 武班、內職並依此品。

translations.literal: Military ranks and inner-service officials all follow these grades.
translations.idiomatic: Military ranks and inner-service officials all follow these grades.

sentences.zh: 大觀二年，定王、嘉王府侍講沈錫等奏：「二王出就外學，其 初見及侍王禮儀、講說疏數之節，請如故事。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Daguan, Lecturers of the Prince of Ding and Prince of Jia Palaces, Shen Xi and others, memorialized: "When the two princes go forth to outer study, their first meeting, the ritual of attending the prince, lecture frequency, and number of sessions— we request that they follow precedent."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daguan, lecturers of the Prince of Ding and Prince of Jia palaces, Shen Xi and others, memorialized: "When the two princes go forth to outer study, their first meeting, the ritual of attending the prince, lecture frequency, and number of sessions—we request that they follow precedent."

sentences.zh: 手詔：「按祥符故事，記室翊善見諸王，皆下拜。

translations.literal: A handwritten edict said: "According to the Xiangfu precedent, Recorders and Companions, when meeting the princes, all bow down.
translations.idiomatic: A handwritten edict stated: "According to the Xiangfu precedent, recorders and companions, when meeting the princes, all bow down.

sentences.zh: 真宗特以張士遜為王友，命王答拜，以示賓禮。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhenzong specially made Zhang Shixun Prince's Friend and ordered the prince to return the bow, to show guest ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhenzong specially made Zhang Shixun the prince's friend and ordered the prince to return the bow, to show guest ritual.

sentences.zh: 今講讀輔翊之官， 職在訓道，亦王友傅也，可如例，令王答拜。」

translations.literal: Now lecturers and assisting officials, whose duty is instruction, are also friends and tutors of the prince; they may follow the precedent, with the prince returning the bow."
translations.idiomatic: Now lecturers and assisting officials, whose duty is instruction, are also friends and tutors of the prince; they may follow the precedent, with the prince returning the bow."

sentences.zh: 群臣赴台參、謝、辭者

translations.literal: When the host of ministers goes to the Censorate to call, give thanks, or take leave
translations.idiomatic: When ministers go to the Censorate to call, give thanks, or take leave

sentences.zh: 〈（新授、加恩、出使者）〉，

translations.literal: (newly appointed, granted favor, or dispatched on mission),
translations.idiomatic: (newly appointed, granted favor, or dispatched on mission),

sentences.zh: 尚書侍郎則三院御史各一員、中丞、大夫皆對拜

translations.literal: Vice Ministers of the Ministry then have one censor from each of the three bureaus; Vice Censor-in-Chief and Censor-in-Chief all exchange bows facing one another
translations.idiomatic: vice ministers of the ministry then have one censor from each of the three bureaus; the vice censor-in-chief and censor-in-chief all exchange bows facing one another

sentences.zh: 〈（三院仍班迎，不 坐班即不赴）〉。

translations.literal: (the three bureaus still form ranks to welcome; if not seated in rank they do not attend)
translations.idiomatic: (the three bureaus still form ranks to welcome; if not seated in rank they do not attend)

sentences.zh: 節度使、賓客、太常宗正卿則御史一員、中丞、大夫皆對拜。

translations.literal: Military Commissioners, Guests, and Ministers of Rites and Imperial Clan then have one censor; Vice Censor-in-Chief and Censor-in-Chief all exchange bows facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioners, guests, and ministers of rites and imperial clan then have one censor; the vice censor-in-chief and censor-in-chief all exchange bows facing one another.

sentences.zh: 兩使留後至刺史、秘書監至五官正、上將軍至郎將、四廂都指揮使及內職軍校遙郡以 上、樞密都承旨及內職帶正員官者、四赤縣令、三京司錄、節度行軍至團練副使、幕職官任憲銜者，皆御史一員對拜，中丞、大夫對揖

translations.literal: Two Commissioners' Acting Commissioners down to Prefect, Director of Secretariat down to Rectifier of the Five Officers, Superior General down to Commandant, Commanders of the Four Wings and inner-service military commissioners of remote commanderies and above, Military Affairs Chief Coordinator and inner-service officials holding regular posts, magistrates of the Four Scarlet Counties, registrars of the Three Capitals, military commissioners of circuits down to Deputy Training Commissioner, administrative staff holding censorial titles—all have one censor exchanging bows facing one another; Vice Censor-in-Chief and Censor-in-Chief exchange bows with hands joined
translations.idiomatic: Two commissioners' acting commissioners down to prefect, director of secretariat down to rectifier of the five officers, superior general down to commandant, commanders of the four wings and inner-service military commissioners of remote commanderies and above, military affairs chief coordinator and inner-service officials holding regular posts, magistrates of the four scarlet counties, registrars of the three capitals, military commissioners of circuits down to deputy training commissioner, administrative staff holding censorial titles—all have one censor exchanging bows facing one another; the vice censor-in-chief and censor-in-chief exchange bows with hands joined

sentences.zh: 〈（亦令揖訖進言，得參風憲， 再揖而退）〉。

translations.literal: (they are also ordered to bow joined, then advance to speak, may participate in censorial oversight, bow joined again and withdraw)
translations.idiomatic: (they are also ordered to bow with hands joined, then advance to speak, may participate in censorial oversight, bow joined again and withdraw)

sentences.zh: 若曾任中書、門下及左右丞皆不赴。

translations.literal: If formerly serving in the Central Secretariat, Gate Secretariat, or as Left and Right Vice Minister, they do not attend.
translations.idiomatic: If formerly serving in the Central Secretariat, Gate Secretariat, or as left and right vice minister, they do not attend.

sentences.zh: 加階勳、食邑、章服，館閣三司、開封府職事及內職轉使額、軍額，亦不赴台謝。

translations.literal: For added rank honors, food fiefs, regalia, Three Institutes and Three Commissions posts, Kaifeng functional posts, and inner-service transfers of commissioner titles and army titles, they also do not go to the Censorate to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: For added rank honors, food fiefs, regalia, Three Institutes and Three Commissions posts, Kaifeng functional posts, and inner-service transfers of commissioner titles and army titles, they also do not go to the Censorate to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 僕射過正衙日，台官大夫以下與 百官，並詣幕次致賀

translations.literal: On days when the Vice Grand Counselor passes the main outer court, Censorate officials from Vice Censor-in-Chief downward together with the myriad officials all go to the tent to offer congratulations
translations.idiomatic: On days when the vice grand counselor passes the main outer court, censorate officials from vice censor-in-chief downward together with the myriad officials all go to the tent to offer congratulations

sentences.zh: 〈（文官一品、二品曾任中書、樞密院者不赴）〉。

translations.literal: (civil officials of the first and second rank who formerly served in the Central Secretariat or Bureau of Military Affairs do not attend)
translations.idiomatic: (civil officials of the first and second rank who formerly served in the Central Secretariat or Bureau of Military Affairs do not attend)

sentences.zh: 大夫、中丞則郎中、少卿監、大將軍以下亦然

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief and Vice Censor-in-Chief likewise treat Directors, Junior Directors, Grand Generals and below the same way
translations.idiomatic: The censor-in-chief and vice censor-in-chief likewise treat directors, junior directors, grand generals and below the same way

sentences.zh: 〈（本官約止則不赴，僕射赴上都省者罷此儀）〉。

translations.literal: (if one's substantive office approximates stopping, they do not attend; when the Vice Grand Counselor goes to the upper Secretariat this ritual is suspended)
translations.idiomatic: (if one's substantive office approximates stopping, they do not attend; when the vice grand counselor goes to the upper Secretariat this ritual is suspended)
